---
title: "Inference costs vs training costs"
claim: "Inference costs of serving a model are now roughly proportional to the initial training costs."
---

**Inference costs of serving a model are now roughly proportional to the initial training costs.**

There is a tradeoff between training cost and inference cost through model size. Larger models will have higher inference costs.

- @epoch2024optimallyallocating concludes AI labs should spend "comparable resources in training and running inference".
